_comment: The list of published articles. This is the ONLY file to edit when you publish:
add one entry at the TOP and the index page, the homepage strip and the article
slug     the file name inside articles/, without .html
title    as it appears in the list and in the browser tab
date     ISO, yyyy-mm-dd. Shown as 3 September 2026.
summary  one or two sentences. This is what a reader decides on.
tags     short labels, two or three at most
Delete nothing to unpublish - move the entry to "drafts" below and the page stays
on the server but drops off every list.

articles.title: The September 2025 rate change, and the two dates that catch people out
articles.summary: Twelve and twenty-eight per cent are gone and forty per cent is not a standard rate. Tobacco kept its old rate for four months longer, and a supply that straddles either change date is not settled by its invoice date.
